390:t_022:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...I'd hate to leave, but I do owe $$アウストラリス$$ a little courtesy.」

390:t_022:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Still, I'm happy. I get to fight such fun opponents again!」

390:t_022:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Bye-bye, Darling! And $c too! I'll be going all out from now on!」

390:t_023:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「All units, fall back! Follow Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

390:t_024:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「She was like a storm...」

390:t_024:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Indeed... I feel like a bullfighter.」

390:t_024:3.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「...A message from the $$マクロス・クォーター$$. They say they're joining us here.」

390:t_025:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, they'll be surprised when they find out who $$ストラウス$$ really is.」

390:t_025:2.en:
$n
「She's still an enemy we have to defeat.」

390:t_025:3.en:
$$メール$$
「I agree with $n! I'll never give Darling to someone like her!」

390:t_025:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
(She's got one hell of a personal grudge.)

390:t_025:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
(You mustn't say that in front of $$メール$$.)

390:t_025:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry, $$メール$$. We're not going to lose to someone like her.」

390:t_026:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even so, it seems to agree with me.」

390:t_026:3.en:
$$ランド$$
(You seem to have been enduring all sorts of things too, $$ガンレオン$$. I guess that's why you couldn't bring out your power properly.)

390:t_026:4.en:
$$ランド$$
(But we've both overcome that. I'm counting on you from here on too, partner.)

390:t_028:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is it resonating with $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ to increase its power...!?」

390:t_028:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Take responsibility and do something, $$ランド$$!」

390:t_028:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course I will! I'll settle things with this bastard!」

390:t_029:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「How careless...! To disgrace myself like this before Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

390:t_029:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't worry, don't worry! As long as you're alive, you can enjoy another battle!」

390:t_029:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Y-yes! Then please excuse me for leaving first!」

390:t_030:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's right. Never giving up is one of $$ダバラーン$$'s good points.」

390:t_030:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And getting so eager to earn a victory in front of his commander... That's my right-hand man!」

390:t_030:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Is that woman as dense as a cow!?」

390:t_030:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「He's the enemy, but I feel a little sorry for that bastard $$ダバラーン$$...」

390:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a shame, $$ストラウス$$! If you weren't our enemy, we might've gotten along pretty damn well!」

390:t_100:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「You think so too!? Then hurry up and leave $$サイデリアル$$!」

390:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you can't do that, you're my enemy! I'll fight you with everything I've got!!」

390:t_101:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Let's have plenty of fun, Darling!」

390:t_101:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Stay away from Darling! You're dangerous!」

390:t_101:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... Are you that scared of me and $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$'s power?」

390:t_101:3.en:
$$メール$$
「That's not it! When it comes to looks, you're exactly Darling's type!」

390:t_101:5.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling, stop drooling over her and fight seriously!」

390:t_101:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right! We can't leave someone who wages war with her desires running wild alone!」

390:t_101:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「OK, Darling! Let's love each other until one of us coughs up blood! With everything we've got!」

390:t_101:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's exactly what I'm saying is wrong!!」

390:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! You, I'll kill with my own hands!!」

390:t_102:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Are you jealous, by any chance?」

390:t_102:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If a little jab from $$メール$$ rattles you, you can't handle that woman, $$ダバラーン$$!」

390:t_102:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! I will protect Lady $$エルーナ$$!!」

390:t_102:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Think about whether that woman's the kind who needs protecting!!」

390:t_103:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're cute! You're so cute, $$セツコ$$!」

390:t_103:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm so happy I get to fight you, $$セツコ$$! I'll never hand you over to someone like $$バルビエル$$!」

390:t_103:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, Supreme Commander of the Imperial Army! I'll defeat you here!」

390:t_103:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's what I like to hear! Put up a little fight, $$悲しみの乙女$$!」

390:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Show me a little resistance, $$揺れる天秤$$!」

390:t_104:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What the hell...? You treat me a lot differently from $$ランド$$.」

390:t_104:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「With men, power beats technique! Pretty boys like you and speedy machines aren't my type!」

390:t_104:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Lucky me. $$スフィア$$s aside, it seems we just don't get along.」

390:t_104:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even though I hate women, I hesitated a little to shoot one. But if that's how you feel, this'll be easy!」

390:t_104:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I won't hold back, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

390:t_104:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aha! Looks like you might give me a little fun! Do your best, $$揺れる天秤$$!」

390:t_105:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I like it! Those attacks walk a fine line between unreasonable, reckless and suicidal! I can feel your youth!」

390:t_105:1.en:
$n
「She's a more advanced Reactor than I am! Unless I push a little harder, I have no chance of winning!」

390:t_105:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh... You understand what matters in a fight!」

390:t_105:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hey, boy! Come join $$サイデリアル$$... No, the $$ハイアデス$$! Fighting alongside you would be fun!」

390:t_105:4.en:
$n
「Sorry, but I don't like sloppy women who give in to their desires.」

390:t_105:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Oh, really? Then entertain me as a worthy rival instead of a comrade!」

390:t_105:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's your role, $$いがみ合う双子$$!!」
